name: Head table
setupLines: Kindred taps a glass. Nobody stops talking. King stands up anyway.
"Whoever gives the toast sits at the head," says Kind. King is already sitting there.
The seating chart has been rewritten three times, all in King's handwriting.

kindred: Ask Kindred, she wrote the guest list.
Kindred keeps the family records. Kindred also keeps grudges.
Kindred hasn't said a word to King all night. That's a word in itself.
kind: Kind knows more than she's letting on. She always does.
Kind has two names on her place card. Ask her why.
Ask Kind. She was there when the family wrote things down.
king: Ask King yourself. He's dying to tell you.
King has a quote ready. He's had it ready for generations.
Someone should ask King for his papers. Nobody has the nerve.
